policy.primaryRule: Core prediction evidence must come from official sources, major sports platforms, or structured sports-data providers. Community and social posts are reference-only leads.
policy.numericDataRule: Player event metrics, lineups, injuries, xG, goalkeeper data, and penalty statistics must come from structured providers, official sources, or major sports platforms with explicit data pages.
policy.communityRule: Social media, forums, comments, and fan posts cannot be used as prediction evidence or numeric inputs. They can only flag topics for verification.
policy.privacyRule: Do not collect private-life claims, gossip, or social speculation unless it is credible, public, directly match-related, and source-verified.
policy.scrapingRule: Prefer APIs, RSS, and official feeds. Do not bypass login, paywalls, CAPTCHA, anti-bot checks, or robots restrictions.
policy.bettingRule: Odds and betting-tip sources are not allowed as primary evidence.
